title: Key Sessions Of The Indian National Congress INC
definition: The chronological milestones and resolutions of the Indian National Congress from 1885 to 1917, reflecting the evolution of Indian nationalism from moderate petitions to assertive extremism and constitutional reunion.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in UPSC Prelims (chronology, presidents, locations, key resolutions) and Mains GS-1 (evolution of national movement, extremist vs moderate dynamics).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational chronology, presidents, and landmark resolutions of key INC sessions.
Evaluate spatial distribution, ideological shifts, and friction points between Moderates and Extremists.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains historical questions.
